_scenario: Cross-timezone (Toronto-local business_date with Pacific UTC timestamp)
_expected_outcome: accept; business_date resolves to the location's local timezone (America/Toronto), NOT to whatever the UTC offset implies
_adapter_assertion: iana_timezone_converter.toBusinessDate uses the location's IANA timezone (from connector_connection.metadata or location.iana_timezone). Even though the UTC timestamp falls within Pacific business hours, the canonical fact's business_date is the Toronto-local date for the close time.
_note: This fixture forces the resolver to choose between (a) the location's IANA timezone and (b) the timezone implied by the UTC instant. The contract requires (a). The closeAt 2026-05-05T05:30:00Z is 22:30 Pacific (PDT, UTC-7) on 2026-05-04 but 01:30 Toronto (EDT, UTC-4) on 2026-05-05 — so the resolver picks 2026-05-05 as business_date. The fixture catches resolvers that accidentally key on the UTC-day or PDT-day.
